hero.heading: Accessories & *Maintenance Products*
hero.body: Nails, infill, weed fabric, putting green accessories, and turf maintenance supplies — everything you need to install and maintain your turf the right way.

products.label: In Stock
products.heading: Shop Accessories & Maintenance Products
products.body: All items stocked at our Queen Creek showroom for same-day pickup. Call ahead to confirm quantity availability.

items.name: Silica Sand 50 Lbs.
items.description: Standard silica sand infill for artificial turf. Adds weight and stability to the turf backing.

items.name: Putting Green Silica Sand 50 Lb.
items.description: Fine-grade silica sand sized for putting green turf. Keeps the surface firm and true-rolling.

items.name: Camofill 50 Lbs.
items.description: Coated sand infill that resists odors and bacteria. Great for pet areas and high-traffic zones.

items.name: 3.5" Install Nails 50 Lbs.
items.description: Galvanized nails for securing turf edges along concrete, wood bender board, and paver borders.

items.name: 5" Install Nails 50 Lbs.
items.description: Longer galvanized nails for perimeter anchoring in decomposed granite and compacted base.

items.name: 6×300 Weed Fabric
items.description: 6-foot-wide, 300-foot roll. Landscape-grade weed barrier installed under the turf base layer.

items.name: EZ Pump 0.5-Gal. Hand Sprayer
items.description: Standalone 0.5-gallon Oxy Turf hand pump sprayer. Mixes and dispenses Oxy Turf cleaner and other turf treatments.

items.name: EZ Pump + Oxy Turf Combo
items.description: Bundle pack: 1-gallon Oxy Turf Cleaner & Deodorizer plus the matching EZ Pump sprayer attachment. Best value for new turf owners.

items.name: Oxy Turf 1-Gal. Jug
items.description: Concentrated oxidizing turf cleaner. Breaks down pet waste, odors, and organic debris at the source.

items.name: Flag Stick
items.description: Standard cup-size flag stick for putting green installations. Fits 4" aluminum cups.

items.name: White Flag
items.description: Classic white putting green flag. Pairs with any flag stick and 4" cup.

items.name: Black & White Checkered Flag
items.description: Checkered putting green flag. A fun finish detail for backyard and practice greens.

items.name: 4" Aluminum Cup
items.description: Standard-size aluminum putting cup. Installs flush into the green surface for a professional look.
